tooltip.relics_thirteenflames.knef_bow.l:
One of the «Flames», legendary artifacts scattered across the world.
Created by Knephmtyti, goddess of Death.
tooltip.relics.knef_bow.leveling:
+1 experience point for each «Moonlight Arrows» hit. 
 +1 experience point for each point of HP healed by «Heaven's Wrath».
tooltip.relics.knef_bow.ability.shot.des: Shoots out multiple beams of moonlight that track nearest targets. Each shot drains the user's HP.
tooltip.relics.knef_bow.ability.swim.des: Using the Bow while submerged will send you forward with great speed, damaging enemies in your way. While it's raining, exiting the water won't interrupt this ability.
tooltip.relics.knef_bow.ability.storm.de:
Holding down Shift while charging the shot and shooting the Arrow into the sky will summon an Eye of the Storm, that will send down thunder and rain, damaging targets below and healing the user. A shot into the ground will create a powerful discharge, striking enemies with chain lightning.
Cooldown: 30 seconds.
tooltip.relics_thirteenflames.ronas_swor:
One of the «Flames», legendary artifacts scattered across the world.
Created by Rhonas, god of War.
tooltip.relics.ronas_sword.leveling:
+1-3 experience points for each «Rhonas' Venom» stack on a slain enemy. 
 25% chance to get +1 experience point for each new «Rhonas' Venom» stack on a target.
Each swiping attack releases a wave of potent venom that seeps further into its targets with every additional hit. Attacking too fast poisons the user instead.
Pressing Shift+RMB with the Fang will create a toxic cloud, poisoning the enemies in its range.
tooltip.relics.ronas_sword.ability.anemi: You feel the poison running through your veins, reducing the amount of healing received from all sources and limiting your prowess with the Fang while the blade is in your inventory.
tooltip.relics_thirteenflames.montu_hamm:
One of the «Flames», legendary artifacts scattered across the world.
Created by Montu, god of Labor.
tooltip.relics.montu_hammer.leveling:
+1 experience point for every 25 blocks mined with the Hammer. 
 +1 experience point for each block of ore extracted with «Montu's Strike».
tooltip.relics.montu_hammer.ability.slap: Pressing Shift+RMB on a block will create a shockwave, causing all ores below to spit out onto the surface.
The power of the God of Labor allows you to tear through the Earth's crust with ease, expanding the mining area. Use Shift + Mouse Wheel to control the Hammer's might.
tooltip.relics_thirteenflames.seliaset_h:
One of the «Flames», legendary artifacts scattered across the world.
Created by Seliaset, goddess of Fertility.
